pack.topic: Heavy Machinery Load Safety & Pit Edge Stability in Coimbatore Sites
pack.source_script_insight: The source video showcases dynamic weight distribution and high rear-wheel point loads under heavy machinery movement. In construction site civil engineering, heavy machinery such as tractors, backhoes, and material dumpers exert massive dynamic point loads on soil. Operating heavy equipment close to unbraced excavation pits can trigger sudden shear collapse of the pit walls.
pack.coimbatore_angle: In Coimbatore construction sites around Saravanampatti, Vadavalli, and Thudiyalur, deep pit excavations for column footings often encounter mixed soil layers (red soil over weathered quartz/gneiss). Moving heavy tractor-trailers carrying steel or backhoes right alongside open excavation edges creates dangerous surcharge loads that destabilize pit margins.
pack.core_takeaway: Always maintain a safe setback distance (at least equal to pit depth) and install slope protection when operating heavy vehicles near site excavation pits.

pack.gemini_video_prompt:
OliveTree Builders, COIMBATORE ONLY, EXACTLY 10 SECONDS, EXACTLY 7 SCENES, PHOTOREALISTIC LIVE-ACTION-STYLE REAL FOOTAGE, 90%+ real-looking visuals, portrait 9:16 vertical video.

SCENE 1 (0.0–1.4s): Real active residential construction site in Coimbatore, red soil ground under bright Indian afternoon sun. A green Mahindra agricultural tractor carrying heavy steel rebar bundles drives dangerously close to an open footing excavation pit. High contrast, realistic dust kicked up by rear tires. Camera at knee height, rapid tracking movement following tire edge. Text overlay: 'DANGER ZONE!'. Voiceover (Tamil): 'குழி அருகே'.

SCENE 2 (1.4–2.8s): Extreme macro close-up of heavy rear tractor tire treads pressing down onto unreinforced red soil bank. Cracks instantly spread along the dirt edge adjacent to the open trench. Photorealistic soil texture, fine sand grains moving, authentic Tamil Nadu clay-gravel soil composition. Static ground-level macro lens. Text overlay: 'HEAVY POINT LOAD'. Voiceover (Tamil): 'டிராக்டர் வேண்டாம்!'.

SCENE 3 (2.8–4.2s): High-angle 45-degree view looking down into a 6-foot deep column footing trench. Soil shear slip occurs under heavy vehicle weight, sending clods of dry red earth tumbling down over exposed leveling concrete (PCC). Natural harsh daylight shadows. Fast tilt down camera movement. Text overlay: 'SOIL SHEAR COLLAPSE'. Voiceover (Tamil): 'சுமை அழுத்தத்தால்'.

SCENE 4 (4.2–5.6s): A civil site supervisor wearing white hardhat and neon yellow safety vest pouring bright white lime powder along the ground, marking a strict 1.5m safety setback boundary line parallel to the footing excavation edge. Realistic site context with red bricks and coconut trees in background. Medium tracking shot. Text overlay: 'SETBACK LINE'. Voiceover (Tamil): 'மண் சரியும்!'.

SCENE 5 (5.6–7.0s): Low-angle perspective looking down the newly marked lime line where heavy-duty yellow and black safety cones are being aligned to block site tractor movement. Sunlight reflecting off hardhat and plastic cones. Dynamic low dolly push shot. Text overlay: 'NO VEHICLE ZONE'. Voiceover (Tamil): 'பாதுகாப்பான'.

SCENE 6 (7.0–8.5s): Wide photorealistic shot showing the red tractor safely parked and unloading steel bundles on a hardened gravel unloading pad positioned 6 meters away from the excavation zone. Neat site organization, workers guiding unloading with ropes. Wide 24mm lens angle. Text overlay: 'SAFE UNLOADING AREA'. Voiceover (Tamil): 'இடைவெளி'.

SCENE 7 (8.5–10.0s): Hero static shot of a pristine, safely excavated column footing pit with timber shoring supports along side walls, clean PCC bed at bottom, surrounded by clear setback boundary markers. Crisp natural lighting, realistic blue sky and local flora in far background. Clean minimalist text overlay: 'OLIVETREE BUILDERS'. Voiceover (Tamil): 'அவசியம்!'.

CONTINUITY & STYLE RULES:
- Maintain consistent sunlight intensity, red clay soil texture, and site environment across all 7 scenes.
- Authentic Coimbatore residential construction site ambiance with local vegetation and realistic construction equipment.
- No cartoon effects, 3D animations, studio graphics, or fake floating CAD models. Only realistic physical overlays.

NEGATIVE PROMPT:
Do NOT include cartoon, toon animation, 3D render, glossy CGI, white background explainer, landscape video, letterboxing, blurred sidebars, generic non-Indian landscapes, fake landmarks, presenter talking directly to camera, audio music overlays, religious symbols, unverified figures.
pack.title_english: Avoid Footing Collapse: Heavy Vehicle Setback Rule
pack.caption_english: Operating heavy tractors or backhoes near open excavation pits is a major cause of soil collapse on Coimbatore construction sites. Soil dynamic surcharge loads create shear failure along unbraced pit margins, endangering site workers and destabilizing foundation beds. Always enforce a strict equipment setback zone equal to or greater than the excavation depth. OliveTree Builders follows rigorous site safety protocols and structural soil management standards across all residential projects in Coimbatore. Build safe, build strong with engineered site discipline.
